Our hotel is conveniently located in the city center, allowing guests to have ample time to explore and experience all that Hanoi has to offer. With the Old Quarter just 270 meters away, guests can dive deep into the culture and history of the city. At San Boutique Hotel, we aim to provide our guests with exceptional services and top-notch facilities to ensure an unforgettable vacation. Stay connected with your loved ones through our complimentary Wi-Fi internet access and enjoy the convenience of our airport shuttle services. Let us help you plan your adventure with our tour and ticket services and indulge in the luxury of our dry cleaning and laundry services. Our rooms are designed to offer ultimate comfort, with blackout curtains, air conditioning, and some rooms featuring a balcony or terrace. Entertain yourself with cable TV or enjoy a refreshing drink from the small refrigerator in some guest rooms. We understand the importance of bathroom amenities, which is why we provide towels, hairdryers, and toiletries in select rooms. Start your day worry-free with our complimentary breakfast, and indulge in the delicious dining options provided at our on-site restaurants. Don’t let hunger affect your travel plans! Our helpful staff is always available at the reception desk to assist with any needs you may have, including luggage storage and customer care services.
